answer: Newcomers arriving through the lagoon gateway must lock a refundable nectar escrow that vests only after a sparrow-witness pair countersigns their first full epoch of honest routing. If that pair later flags a duplicate identity, the escrow burns and each approving witness forfeits 40 POA from its own stake. An attacker therefore pays one escrow plus 40 POA per fake identity, while honest members reclaim their deposit at the next checkpoint.
